historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR 12.5% diverges >30% from revenue CAGR 24.0%: book growth is held down by payouts (dividends + buybacks 66% of FY2025 adjusted profit, 121% in 26H1). Owner-FCF CAGR is sharply negative while reported FCF is flat because lease payments (346M -> 897M) and SBC (63M -> 368M) grew far faster than FCF as the company moved to directly-operated overseas stores.
historical_growth.notes: Period-length adjusted: the June-FYE annuals (FY2020-FY2023) and the Dec-FYE annuals (FY2024-FY2025) are spanned with fractional years (FY2022-Jun -> FY2025-Dec = 3.5y; FY2020-Jun -> FY2025-Dec = 5.5y; FY2021-Jun -> FY2025-Dec = 4.5y for equity, FY2020 equity negative pre-IPO). The Jul-Dec 2023 stub is not used as an endpoint. EPS 5yr n/a (FY2020/FY2021 losses from preferred-share fair-value charges). Owner FCF = reported FCF - lease cash (principal+interest) - SBC - interest income when net cash is material: FY2023-Jun 1,491.9 - 346.0 - 62.9 - 145.2 = 937.8; FY2024 1,405.8 - 725.1 - 85.2 - 118.7 = 476.8; FY2025 1,580.2 - 897.5 - 367.9 - 0 (net cash ~nil after Yonghui loans) = 314.8. fcf_3yr_cagr is FY2023-Jun -> FY2025 (2.5y). FY2025 owner FCF is also depressed by a tariff-driven inventory build (international inventory turnover 228 days).

scenario_narratives.base: Core MINISO keeps growing low-double-digits as China (+26% in 26H1) and North America (+37%) carry the group, but the 2026 margin reset proves only partly temporary: pre-lease EBITDA ~20% in FY2026, recovering to 21.5% -- about 4pp below FY2024 because the overseas directly-operated model carries rent, labour and IP licensing that the franchise model did not. Yonghui is valued at its depressed market price less a block discount, not on management's turnaround narrative.
scenario_narratives.bull: IP + large-format pivot works: YOYO and other proprietary IP scale (RMB100M+/month), MINISO Land stores lift GMV density, US stores mature into profitable growth and TOP TOY keeps 30%+ growth. Margins recover most of the 2026 dip; the market's ~8x adjusted-earnings multiple re-rates as the leverage is shown to be serviceable.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 guide-down is the start of structural margin erosion: overseas same-store GMV keeps falling, tariffs and licensing costs bite, China competition (KKV, e-commerce value retail) caps SSSG, and the debt-funded Yonghui stake continues to be marked down -- capital that earned nothing for MINISO's owners.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the core MINISO/TOP TOY retail franchise on owner FCF after leases and SBC, in RMB per ADS, and add the non-operating stakes (Yonghui at market less a discount, the AI LP at fair value) separately rather than letting their mark-to-market noise drive the operating base. Leverage that funded those stakes is deducted in full, with the Equity Linked Securities at principal.
key_risks_to_valuation: Yonghui stake value: RMB6.8bn in the bridge is ~1/3 of the market cap; Yonghui fell from RMB4.69 (Dec-25) to RMB2.99 and the stake is pledged against the acquisition loans
Margin reset: each 1pp of pre-lease EBITDA margin is ~RMB1bn+ of terminal EV; FY2024's 25.5% is not assumed to return
Lease load rising with directly-operated overseas stores (lease liabilities +25% in 26H1); treatment (B) charges it in the flows
China ADS holding-structure risk (HFCAA, RMB conversion, tariffs) -- charged once in the 10.5% CNY WACC
Equity Linked Securities put at par Jan-2028 (US$550M) -- refinancing need alongside the Yonghui loans

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (MNSO, USD per ADS) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 8.55-23.10. FX Yahoo CNY=X / HKDCNY=X; parity vs 9896.HK. Yonghui 601933.SS close 2026-09-30.
data_sources.financials: MNSO_Metrics.csv / MNSO.duckdb (core_metrics, kpis); 20-F FY2025 (lease note 20(c), ROU depreciation note, EPS note, Yonghui associate note, ELS terms); 6-K FY2025-Dec and H1-2026 (non-IFRS reconciliations, balance sheet at 2026-06-30).
data_sources.qualitative: MNSO_Analysis.json (2026-10-04), incl. Q2 2026 earnings-call guidance (H2 revenue high-single-digit growth, adjusted operating margin -3 to -4pp).

inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-EQUIVALENTS, not ordinary shares: ~1,215M fully diluted ordinary shares / 4 ordinary shares per ADS = 303.75M ADS-equivalents, so every per-share value is per ADS and comparable to the NYSE quote. 1,215M is derived from the H1 FY2026 6-K EPS denominators (basic and diluted weighted ~1,217M: RMB961.6M / RMB0.79), less late-H1 repurchases (RMB517.6M bought back in 26H1), plus unvested awards. Cross-check: 1,237,564,177 ordinary shares issued at 2025-12-31 (20-F, includes ESOP-trust/treasury shares; FY2025 weighted basic 1,226.5M). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The US$550M 2032 Equity Linked Securities are CASH-settled (no shares delivered; exercise HK$64.395/share, deeply out of the money) and are carried as debt at principal, so they add no shares.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 6-K (FY2025-Dec) non-IFRS reconciliation: equity-settled share-based payment expenses RMB367,869k; EquityAwardTaxes kpi = 0 every year (no net-share-settlement tax line in the cash flow statement). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB123.7M (1.08% of revenue).
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY, IFRS). Quote is USD per NYSE ADS (1 ADS = 4 Class A ordinary shares). fx_rate = USD per CNY = 1/6.6987 (Yahoo CNY=X, 2026-10-03T21:32Z). Per-share values are computed in CNY per ADS and multiplied by 0.149283. Parity check against the HKEX line 9896.HK: HK$17.61 x 4 = HK$70.44 per ADS-equivalent; USD/HKD = 6.6987 / 0.8534 (HKDCNY=X) = 7.849, so HK$70.44 = US$8.97 per ADS-equivalent, within 1.6% of the NYSE close at inputs.price_as_of (HK close 2026-10-02 08:08Z vs NY close 20:00Z) -- confirms rate direction and the 4:1 ratio.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: 31 December (changed from 30 June; Jul-Dec 2023 transition stub)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y government yield ~1.8% + China equity risk premium ~7.0% (incl. country premium) x beta ~1.1 = ~9.5% cost of equity, plus ~1pp for holding-structure risk that the operating scenarios cannot express (Cayman/VIE-adjacent ADS, HFCAA/PCAOB delisting tail, US-China tariff/geopolitics, RMB conversion) -> ~10.5%. Debt is a small share of capital at market value and the after-tax cost of the Yonghui loans and 0.5% ELS is low, but the leverage is recent and pledged; WACC held at 10.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: operating risk is charged in the scenario flows, not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as an operating cost. Company adjusted EBITDA is pre-IFRS-16 (adds back all D&A incl. right-of-use depreciation and lease interest), so lease_cost_pct_path deducts the full lease payment: FY2025 'payment of capital element and interest element of lease liabilities' RMB897.5M (20-F note 20(c), within financing cash flows) = 4.19% of revenue. Short-term/variable lease cash (RMB248.5M, within operating cash flows) is already an expense inside EBITDA. Lease liabilities (RMB4,577.8M at 2026-06-30) are EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 1,206.3 total - 926.3 ROU = 280.0, 1.31% of revenue) so cash-tax EBIT does not charge the lease twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is small (RMB110.1M book at 2026-06-30, mostly TOP TOY minorities); deducted once in the bridge at book, flows are consolidated. The TOP TOY preferred shares' redemption liability (RMB602.7M) is a separate claim, deducted in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF component route (operating specialty retailer/brand-franchisor; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md 'operating company, non-US' row + owner-fcf-adaptations: dual currency, IFRS-16 leases, NCI, non-operating stakes). First valuation of MNSO (no MEMORY.md entry). FY0 = FY2025 (first clean Dec-year annual after the FYE change); balance sheet is the later 2026-06-30 interim. FY2026 (year 1) is ~3/4 elapsed and is discounted a full year -- slightly conservative. Margin anchor: company adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC, pre-IFRS16) less finance income and ex-FX: FY2025 4,959.9 - ~104 interest income = ~22.6%; H1 FY2026 2,255.5 + 142.4 FX loss - 32.7 finance income = 2,365 = 20.6%. YONGHUI: the equity-method share of Yonghui profit/loss is excluded from the flows (it is excluded from adjusted EBITDA by the company too), so the FY2025 RMB812.7M Yonghui loss and the RMB158M-ish redemption-liability charge do not depress the operating base; the matching asset (the 29.4% stake) is added in the bridge at market less a discount instead. Likewise the AI limited-partnership (MiniMax) mark-to-market swings (+277M 26H1, -597M 26Q2) are out of the flows and the investment is in the bridge at its 2026-06-30 carrying fair value. FY2022 one-off RMB944M land-use-right payment is not used as a capex base (capex path anchors to FY2025 4.65% and H1 FY2026 6.3%). Interest income is NOT deducted from last_fcf: the company is now in net debt (RMB1.25bn ex-leases), so the matching-asset rule has no cash pile to protect; the component EBITDA is built ex finance income and cash is netted in the bridge. Buybacks: RMB535.2M FY2025, RMB517.6M 26H1 -- a repurchaser well in excess of SBC, so the flat count is funded. Equity Linked Securities (US$550M, 0.5%, due 2032, holder put Jan-2028/Jan-2030, CASH-settled) carried at principal: the borrowings line carries only the accreted liability component (~RMB2.44bn est. at 2026-06-30), so the bridge adds the ~RMB1,295M gap to principal (550 x 6.7851 = 3,731.8); the embedded-derivative liability (858.7M) and the call-spread asset (321.9M) are both left out because principal is the cash the holders will put back.

bear.narrative: China variety retail commoditises (KKV, Pinduoduo/Douyin value retail) and SSSG turns flat-to-negative; overseas same-store GMV keeps declining (low-single-digit decline in 26H1) while the directly-operated fleet and tariffs keep S&D elevated, so pre-lease EBITDA settles at ~18.5% with a heavier lease load. Growth fades to low single digits after store additions slow.

base.narrative: FY2026 ~+14.5% (H1 +22.4% reported; H2 guided to high-single-digit on tougher comps), adjusted pre-lease EBITDA ~20% as the H2 margin guide-down (adj. operating margin -3 to -4pp YoY on overseas direct-store investment, licensing and payroll) lands, then a slow recovery to 21.5% as US stores mature and own-IP (YOYO) carries more of the mix -- still below FY2024's ~25%. Lease charge rises to ~5.3% of revenue with the directly-operated overseas fleet.
base.cash_tax_rate_note: Adjusted ETR 24.8% in 26H1 (18.4% a year earlier); PRC statutory 25%, overseas losses limit relief. FY2025 cash taxes RMB769M.
base.wc_capture_note: Negative: inventory + receivables less payables ~11.6% of FY2025 revenue (3,691 + 3,307 - 4,516 = 2,482); growth consumes cash.

bull.narrative: The 2026 margin dip is investment, not erosion: US directly-operated stores keep their mid-to-high-teens SSSG and reach mature store margins, TOP TOY (+33% in 26H1) becomes a second engine, MINISO Land large-format stores and YOYO-type proprietary IP lift gross margin and cut licensing cost, and pre-lease EBITDA recovers toward 23.5% (still below FY2024's 25.5%). China SSSG holds mid-single-digit.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (up from the 15% default): FY2026 adjusted operating profit guided down, 26Q2 a reported net loss, overseas same-store GMV declining, and a ~RMB8.6bn debt load taken on for a non-core grocery stake. Base 50%: H1 revenue still +22% with China SSSG positive and strong operating cash conversion. Bull 20% (down from 35%): it needs US store maturity, IP margin uplift AND a benign tariff/geopolitical path at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.

diagnosis.detail: Structural risks in the qualitative analysis that a standard WACC may not price: regulatory single point of failure

sanity_check.fix_applied: NONE - trip diagnosed as a sanity_check.py denomination artefact, not a valuation error. (1) Historical prices: USD-per-ADS closes are MULTIPLIED by fx_rate 0.1493 (should be divided, i.e. x6.6987) and the 4:1 ADS ratio is ignored, so historical per-share prices are ~11.2x too low (FY2025 used 2.72 vs correct ~RMB30.5/share); fy_end_month is also learned as 6 (June) though FYE moved to December in 2023. (2) Implied multiples: base IV 17.99 USD/ADS is used as if RMB/share (correct 17.99 x 6.6987 / 4 = RMB30.13/share), understating implied multiples 1.67x. Corrected: implied P/E ~44x vs historical SBC-adj P/E 15.6-44.7x (avg ~27x, trip at 2x avg = 55x) -> pass; implied P/B ~3.5x vs historical 2.3-5.8x -> pass; implied EV/EBITDA ~8x on FY2025 EBITDA less SBC vs ~9-10x historical -> pass. Implied P/E is elevated only because FY2025 IFRS EPS carries the RMB813M Yonghui equity-method loss, which the flows exclude. No WACC premium added: the 'regulatory single point of failure' (HFCAA/ADS) is already charged as +1pp in the 10.5% CNY WACC. Same class as memory notes sanity-check-ads-denomination-bug and sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-conflict.
